name: wt
description: The worktree you are in, as wt sees it: how far behind trunk, its own remote, and wt up, undo and push from a small dialog. Optional: open it in gittree, and when this conversation last ran a review

gittree.title: Gittree
gittree.description: Offer to open the worktree in gittree (a word to click above the prompt, g in the dialog, and /wt gittree)

reviewStatus.title: Review status
reviewStatus.description: Keep when this conversation last ran a review skill and when you last typed, and show them above the prompt once they are old, and in the dialog

inputAfterMinutes.title: Last input after
inputAfterMinutes.description: With review status on: minutes after which your last input shows above the prompt

reviewAfterMinutes.title: Review after
reviewAfterMinutes.description: With review status on: minutes after which the last review, or the lack of one, shows above the prompt

reviewSkills.title: Review skills
reviewSkills.description: A skill counts as a review when its name matches this regular expression. The default takes every skill with "review" in its name but the one about receiving a review
